models.name: Qwen3.8-27B (PS5LM native GPU app on a jailbroken PS5)
models.why: A jailbroken PS5 Slim's RDNA 2 GPU reached through Mihawk-99's RADV/Mesa Vulkan driver for llama.cpp: PS5LM's table lists about 20 tok/s on Qwen3.8-27B at 64K context, where the earlier CPU-only payload managed about a token a minute. A narrow demo, not a controlled benchmark.

engines.hardware: Jailbroken PS5 Slim, 16GB unified GDDR6 (448 GB/s peak), RDNA 2 GPU via Mihawk-99's RADV/Mesa Vulkan driver
engines.quant: UD-Q2_K_XL 9.83GB (9.15 GiB) weight file; ~20 tok/s with 64k context, per PS5LM's own table (the post does not give the test's prompt length, workload or concurrency, so speed at a full 64k-token input is not established); Vulkan via Mihawk-99's RADV/Mesa driver on RDNA 2
